title: 17 April 1964: Filming: A Hard Day's Night
content:
This was the second and final day of filming at the exclusive London private members’ club Les Ambassadeurs, following an earlier shoot on 17 March 1964.

On this day The Beatles filmed the dancing sequences at the club’s Garrison Room. The scene was soundtracked by the songs ‘I Wanna Be Your Man’ and ‘Don’t Bother Me’.

During a break in filming, The Beatles also gave an interview to US TV host Ed Sullivan in the club’s walled garden. Lasting just one minute and 34 seconds, the chat was included in the 24 May 1964 edition of The Ed Sullivan Show, along with a clip of The Beatles miming to ‘You Can’t Do That’. The performance had been filmed in the Scala Theatre in London, but was later dropped from the final cut of A Hard Day’s Night.
